notes.title: Game Update: Swamp Gnomes
notes.notes:
Hello there!

September has arrived, the leaves are starting to fall, and with it comes some exciting news: two little houses in Moss Glade are now open!
The Swamp Gnomes, long-time residents of the village, have returned from their summer vacation. 
You can now find them hidden around Moss Glade or busy in their tiny homes - good luck spotting them! 🍄🐸


Changelog game version 1.2.2:


🌿 New content in this update:

57 Swamp Gnomes to discover

Two new tiny homes: Boletus House & Pollen House

3 brand-new achievements to unlock


🛠️ What’s improved:

Hints now work for secrets - After finding all frogs, toads, and gnomes, hints will now help you uncover hidden secrets too.

Settings improvements - All gameplay-related options are now visible in the settings screen, including info about the day/night cycle and optional color mode. 

Map improvements - Each location now displays exactly what’s still missing, making it easier to track your progress.

Uncle Froger’s quest screen updated - We’ve clarified what needs to be found to complete the game, and added there a list of secret hints.

Main Menu updated - Uncle Froger now has a “!” icon to better highlight the main quest. Website and Discord links are now available directly from the main screen!

 
Yes! We make our own Discord server, to make your communication even better. We will be showing development progress there, some art stuff and more, so hop in!


Thank you also for over 50 reviews. We’re so happy to see you’re enjoying the game! 💚





Have a good time again in Moss Glade, and see you soon,

Dorota & Aleksander

₍𝄐⩌𝄐₎

notes.title: Update in the Making & New Game Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello there!



It’s been just over a month since Find My Frogs was released, and we’re so excited by all the wonderful reviews and the love you've shown the game so far. Thank you so much! 💚



We're currently working on a new update for Find My Frogs, which will include various improvements based on your feedback plus brand-new locations and characters to discover. 


Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming in the next update:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482023/6f023c134151621952e9b19a34ba01105f670681.png"]

Who can live here...?



Alongside the update, we’re also working on a new game set in the world of Moss Glade.


We’re happy to announce Find My Frogs: Branches!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3948760/Find_My_Frogs_Branches/"][/dynamiclink]This time, you’ll be searching for adorable frogs and toads high up in the ancient tree crown, with new quests from Uncle Froger. Want to know more? Visit Find My Frogs: Branches on Steam and wishlist it so you don’t miss any updates! 🐸



Finally, a small favor: If you have a minute, please consider leaving a Steam review for Find My Frogs! We’re just 6 away from 50, and hitting that milestone helps Steam show our game to more people. For a tiny studio like ours, it makes a big difference.💚



Thanks for being here with us and speak to you soon,

Dorota & Aleksander

₍𝄐⩌𝄐₎

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello there!

The frogs are ready and the village is waiting to be explored!

We’re so excited to announce that Find My Frogs launches on July 23rd.



To celebrate, we’ve put together a brand-new trailer made entirely from actual gameplay, and it’s already live on Steam! 



Stay tuned, and don’t forget to wishlist the game if you haven’t yet:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130800/Find_My_Frogs/"][/dynamiclink]



We can’t wait to hear what you think!



Thank you so much for being here with us,

Dorota & Aleksander
